# Overland Collective

> Overland Collective acquires and operates RV parks and mobile home parks across the United States.

Overland Collective was built on a simple conviction: communities deserve owners who stay. We acquire RV parks and mobile home parks not to strip and resell, but to invest in them for the long haul, upgrading infrastructure, sharpening operations, and building places people are proud to call home. Brokers, wholesalers, and bird dogs can send us deals that fit our buy box.

## Pages

- [Home](https://overlandparkscollective.com/): About Overland Collective, our RV park and mobile home park buy boxes, and the form to send us a deal.
- [Resources](https://overlandparkscollective.com/resources/): Free resources for bird dogs, wholesalers, and brokers working with Overland Collective.
- [Bird Dog Guide](https://overlandparkscollective.com/resources/bird-dog-guide.html): Free step-by-step guide to finding and packaging RV park and mobile home park deals for Overland Collective.
